main_body: A sandstone building with a flat terrace roof carrying a teal dome, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a lattice window
top_band: Sand-coloured flat roof surface, rows ~3-33, with a lighter front-edge band at rows ~30-33 and a parapet rim on the back and sides
evidence: Reading down the middle column: the roof is a wide speckled sand surface with a raised inner rim and a dome standing on it. It ends in a light front-edge band at rows 30-33. A dark brown eave line at rows 34-35 follows, then the brick front face with mortar courses. The door has a pale frame and a dark inset interior, and the window has a lattice and a sill, so both read as recessed. The roof is tall, but it reads clearly as a horizontal surface because of the parapet, the dome base and the speckle. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: Outlines and mortar are dark brown beside the sandstone, and the dome's outline is dark teal, so they follow the material tone rather than near-black. The dome has about 5 teal steps. The roof has several sand tones with speckle. The brick has 3-4 tones with per-brick variation. The door and the dome base are somewhat flatter than the reference tiles, and the roof speckle is sparse. Overall it is slightly thinner than the Beodeul reference but acceptable beside it.
